### Open business questions
- Q1 [blocking] Missing step (steps 2-3): What happens between step 2 and step 3? What does the invited member do with the invite?
- Q2 [blocking] Done when (whole journey): What counts as the end of this journey?
- Q3 [blocking] Entry (step 1): Where does the team admin start an invite?
- Q4 [blocking] Expiry (step 3): When do the 7 days start counting? What happens to the invite, and what does the invited person see if they open it after it expires?
- Q5 [blocking] Validation (steps 1-2): Which email addresses are accepted and which are refused? What happens if the email already belongs to a team member or already has a pending invite?
- Q6 [minor] Loading (step 2): What does the team admin see while the invite is being sent?
- Q7 [minor] Error (steps 1-2): What happens, and what does the team admin see, when the invite can't be sent?
- Q8 [minor] Success (steps 1-3): What does the team admin see after sending? What does the invited member receive? Who is told when an invite expires?
- Q9 [minor] Reload and back (steps 1-2, whole journey): What is kept if the team admin reloads, goes back or leaves before sending, and after sending?
- Q10 [minor] Permissions (steps 1-3): Besides team admins, who may invite, see pending invites or act on an invite before it expires?
- Q11 [minor] Permission change (whole journey): What happens to a pending invite if the inviting admin loses the admin role or leaves the team?
